Hi there trainers,
Thanks for a busy middle; the welfare officer brought up a thought on staff briefings.

Please keep the tone short, calm, and useful when you cover pet handling notes with crews. If a traveler raises an issue, answer with clear steps and avoid extra chatter. <<FACT F120>> Keep the handover tidy so the next team can pick up the file without guesswork.

Also, when a delay affects a pet booking, log the details in plain language and stay consistent with the standard message. <<FACT F109>> That keeps Aurelia Skyways aligned and helps the Companion Animal Travel Desk give the same steady guidance every time. Please review your notes before you send them and keep them practical.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
